meta_description: Boone & Son serving Rich Square - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: Towing in Rich Square, and straight answers.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
card_about: Who you are calling, and the work we do in Rich Square.
coverage_h2: Also serving the towns around Rich Square
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. We work out of Rich Square and the towns around it.
area_h2: The towns around Rich Square, too
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.evidence: White semi tractor with a log-hauling trailer chassis parked at sunset in a field

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.evidence: White heavy-duty flatbed rollback truck parked on a gravel lot

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.evidence: White semi tractor with a log-hauling trailer chassis parked at sunset in a field

gallery.alt: Three semi tractors, a dark blue day cab, a maroon and silver sleeper Kenworth, and a light blue Freightliner, parked nose-out in a gravel lot with a tree line behind them.
Blue Kenworth rotator wrecker with a black boom and winch equipment parked on gravel in front of a brick house with a small red wreath on the door.
White Peterbilt tractor with an empty flatbed log trailer and vertical steel stake bunks parked on gravel under a pink and orange sunset sky.

reviews.author: Teleshia Edwards
reviews.text: Very fast and cost efficient service. I recommend Boone and sons towing to anyone that’s looking for a reliable and dependable towing service

reviews.author: Alfred Kwasikpui
reviews.text: The AAA towing contractor said to wait several days and to leave my truck that was stuck on an icy road. I called Antonio Tann and crew from Boone & Son who brought equipment, including 4-wheelers, a trailer with winch and cables and they got my truck off of the slick road without any damage, without me leaving my truck on an isolated road for several days. and the charge was very reasonable.

reviews.author: Alvester Deloatch
reviews.text: Thanks to Boone & Son Trucking ,Towing Services was there when we needed them what a blessing showed up & got us back on the road again. Arrived quickly & worked swift but professionalism I would say doing it right was our experience we received from them what a great company also a good price for the service rendered Thanks & keep up the good work . I would recommend this company for service if you need help just call & see for yourself what a great team.

reviews.author: Shanika Keyes
reviews.text: This was such a great experience when I was in a bind. Tony came right away when I was stuck with a flat tire to tow me to a tire shop. He even offered to help find a tire and was very helpful the entire time. I highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Davon Williams
reviews.text: You’d think he was Tony the Tiger off the Frosted Flakes box “They’re GREAT” from pulling me out a ditch to changing tires, oil changes, brake adjustments, replacing leaf springs. The man get the job done reasonable price and in a timely fashion. Highly recommended(BTW HE got my semi out ditch truck and trailer)

reviews.author: Diamond Davis
reviews.text: Boone and Son Towing and Repair is a very professional, reliable, and affordable company. I've used this company on several different occasions, and each time they have showed up in a timely manner, with positive attitudes, and very reasonable. I recommend giving Tony a call for all of your towing, recovery, and trucking needs.

reviews.author: Antwanette Smith
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this towing service. They arrived quickly, handled my vehicle with care, and were very professional and courteous. Pricing was fair and there were no surprises. Would definitely used them again.

reviews.author: Anthony Barkley
reviews.text: Called to get a pick up moved from 1 place to another, they jumped right on the job. You could tell this wasn't their first rodeo. They were very professional and respectful, they did a amazing job all while being very affordable. I won't hesitate to call them again!!!

reviews.author: Alexander Creecy
reviews.text: My truck was broke down on side of road and I can say. Those guys are on top of their game, from start to finish. The professionalism, getting the service done in timely manner, down to the Servicing it self. I can I had no complaints.

reviews.author: Felicia Ramsey-Green
reviews.text: The process itself was awesome but he told us he would be here in 30 minutes I'm sure it was more like 20 and he had it done within 11 minutes.

reviews.author: J R Foster
reviews.text: I used this company on 2 different occasions,each time they responded in a very reasonable time & handled the situation quickly. Very impressed with the safety measures they took with themselves & my equipment. Thanks guys!! On The Road Again!!!

reviews.author: Grady Peebles
reviews.text: I’ve used them on several occasions for the last few years and every time they work on super their race are great and they always on time so I have no complaints. I just appreciate them.

reviews.author: Anthony Arrington
reviews.text: My mom call me and told me her truck won’t start. I couldn’t get to her so I called Boone and son LLC They quickly got to her, great men very professional reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Donald Phillips
reviews.text: I called Boone towing service. They came soon as I called. They took real good care of my equipment and I had to recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Aj Tann jr
reviews.text: Boone & Son Trucking is a top-notch company. They are reliable, professional, and truly care about doing the job right. Communication is excellent.

reviews.author: Randolph Powell
reviews.text: When I need help I call Boone and sons they are really consistent and reliable!! I have a log truck business and they keep me on the road!!!!

reviews.author: Gena Jackson
reviews.text: Needed them twice in 1 day they was on time took care of me real good. If you break down they are your guys to call.

reviews.author: Ayesha Harry
reviews.text: Great company, they are, courteous and very professional. I called to get my mom car towed and they came on out and got the job done.

reviews.author: Shantell Taylor
reviews.text: Tony was excellent and responded promptly. He suggested a local repair shop. His customer service and attentiveness were outstanding. I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: kimaya chrishae
reviews.text: This company is built on hard work and dedication. Very professional and dependable service I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Lakeshia Tann
reviews.text: Great person. Very honest. Extremely reliable. He’s the person to call for all your needs anytime and any day!

reviews.author: Angelia Tann
reviews.text: For your towing service 24/7 . Call anytime. Great service and awesome customer service. I called him and he came right away .

reviews.author: Sonija Whitted
reviews.text: The best company Ive ever encountered!! When you call they come, no problems at all. Quick and on time!!! Any problems give these guys a call!!!

reviews.author: Tiffanie Eason
reviews.text: For reasonable prices at anytime day or night Boone and Son is definitely recommended. Nothing to big or small for them to tow or fix from cars to 18wheelers.

reviews.author: Justin Curry
reviews.text: Great service, stand up guy and team. Will come directly to you with little to no wait. Give a call for all your repair

reviews.author: Dooley Riddick
reviews.text: Have done alot of repair work for me prices are great and always done a good job they will never let you down .

reviews.author: Shawn Walton
reviews.text: Always on time and will work with you. He does most of my work on my truck and get the job done right

reviews.author: Brent Futrell
reviews.text: Very pleased, quickly and very professional work done. Will definitely call again for a vehicle that was more of a struggle but he made it onto his bed as smooth as possible in a timely manner.
